info.title: SkillLock — audits the agent skills (SKILL.md) your NuGet packages and repository bring in.
info.description: Audits the agent skills (SKILL.md) that arrive with your NuGet packages and your repository: finds prompt injection, hidden Unicode, remote code execution, secret access and exfiltration, and locks every skill by hash so a package update cannot change what your coding agent reads without review.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: [path] [options]   Record the reviewed skills in skills.lock.json

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to a file

options.name: --lock
options.description: Lock file (default: skills.lock.json in the path or a parent, up to the repo root)

options.name: --accept-findings
options.description: lock: record error findings as accepted after review

options.name: --no-color
options.description:
Plain output
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 usage or configuration error.
